* The figure below shows a household heater.

(a) You feel warm if you put your hand in front of an operating heater. Name the main type of
heat transfer from the heater to your hand. (1 mark)


(b) The heater is placed in an empty room of dimension 3 m x 3m x 3 m.
(i) The air density is 1.29 kg m°. What is the mass of air in this room? Assume that the

volume of the heater is negligible. (1 mark)

(ii) The heater operates at a power of 1500 W. The specific heat capacity of air is about

1000 J kg! °C". If the heater is switched on for an hour, estimate the rise in
temperature of the air in the room. Assume that air does not move in or out of the

room and the air absorbs all the energy radiated from the heater. (2 marks)
(iii) Practically, the temperature rise is far less than that in (ii). Give a reason for this.
(1 mark)
